policy: Every 'verified' entry names a real, currently-passing test file and command in this repository. Requirements whose only remaining evidence is a browser (Playwright/Chromium) check are marked 'unverified' here because the browser dependency cannot be installed in this offline environment — the check is not run and is never reported as passed.
browser_blocker: pnpm install @playwright/test failed with ETIMEDOUT (registry.npmjs.org unreachable); Chromium can therefore not be provisioned, so tests/browser/*.spec.cjs cannot execute locally.

requirements.note: E2E qualification regression kept; the 371/93 frozen replay is unavailable so it stays unverified (not substituted with the 66-batch freeze).
Trusted PR association recovery, in-place recovery with migration records and propagated source failures.
Whole-batch deletion attack is rejected by the pre-publish gate.
Coverage categories and closure kept; Triton full-source enumeration, derived-sampling-not-full-pass and PR #2513-unverified are pinned.
Counting ledger separates raw/unique/public/out-of-window/other; 887/885 gap stays honest unverified.
Time/status/quality/unit axes kept independent; named duration boundary values and 21.68-day extreme retention pinned; public wiring partially pending.
Per-PR longest representative batch and merged cross-repo P90 kept.
JSON/CSV/qualification/fingerprint consistency kept; UDR-026/029 accept the public bundle.
Concern dedupe and history kept; public attention/history wiring pending.
Route entry and mutually exclusive main views kept.
Workbench expresses only real known status.
Detail/chart resource lifecycle kept.
Full-read timeout/concurrency/failure preservation kept (cache-chain fails only on Windows/WSL environment).
Narrow-screen fields and keyboard paths kept.
Fixed-task navigation spec has no runnable browser here; model tests are not a substitute.
S/L search isolation kept; the advanced-sample-filter browser entry has no runnable browser.
Detail model kept; the unified-detail browser entry has no runnable browser.
Stable sort + pagination model kept; the unified-records browser entry has no runnable browser.
Export metadata compatibility kept; the versioned export browser entry has no runnable browser.
URL query-state/model kept; full back/forward restore browser entry has no runnable browser.
Real adapter protocol and validation propagation kept.
Project artifact isolation and trusted load kept; full attack matrix (duplicate, stale attempt, unknown/disabled project, hash/missing/escape, ownership) pinned.
Legacy UBS collection failure cannot fake green.
Single production round orchestration: shared cutoff, per-project deadlines, wait-for-all, precheck isolation.
FIFO whole-round queue, mutual-exclusion release lock, anti-old-overwrite gating.
Complete bundle build and verification, version-mixing and closure checks.
Degraded release with verified-archive fallback and baseline-fault blocking.
Persistent verified baseline, immutable archive, atomic non-force pointer promotion.
Public byte-level verification with transient retry and receipts.
Real recovery deployment from archive + post-rollback re-verification.
Cache/source/public/permission boundaries; Pages/OIDC write scoped to deploy job.
Three-axis run report with honest unknowns; the collection-status browser entry has no runnable browser.
Scheduled freshness and public health checks kept.
Third project joins by config through the shared chain; 25h window not rounded, no community branch.
Stable composite identity, duration precision and explicit metric-profile compatibility pinned; old-CLI byte-for-byte migration parity remains to be supplemented.
PR quality gate and main protection kept; Pages/OIDC permission scope tightened.
README and design doc contracts kept.
Spec structure validation and this per-AC acceptance ledger.
